text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Here we go, here we go, here we go! Toward 
the Kikuka Sho!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Lord Gimlet, Lord Kris S, the next race 
will settle it! I shall strike you both 
down—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I shall advance—to the next stage!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"For that reason, I shall leave no regrets 
in this contest! Come at me as if your 
lives depended on it!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Zoryaaaaaaahhh!!
choice_data_list: Looking good, No Reason!
It's okay, No Reason!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
――Staking it all on one roll of the dice. 
No Reason's intensity as he threw himself 
into training was astounding.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"This is the milestone! This is the big 
showdown! If I don't put on a flawless 
performance here—"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
It would be a disgrace to my name as a 
warlord. I'll show you the race of a 
lifetime!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, storm clouds suddenly gather. The 
turbulent Classic race is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Things didn't go the way No Reason had 
hoped.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ghk... To think the scorching heat 
residing in these legs refuses to 
subside...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now that it's come to this—shall I cast 
myself into the crater of no return? Only 
to become a single passage in the history 
books.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S! Tanino Gimlet has 
announced an indefinite suspension of her 
racing career, do you have any comments?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, our paths have... diverged. I shall 
walk... Destiny's path."

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
By 'destiny'... you mean the Kikuka Sho, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
No. I will not run the Kikuka Sho. Next 
is—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: It's the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ooooo!)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: What... is the meaning of this...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"What in the world is the meaning of 
this?! Speak, explain yourself, Trainer!!"
choice_data_list:
Calm down. But... this is way beyond what 
I expected...

Calm down. But... this is way too 
unexpected...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The tactical formation I had envisioned 
instantly turned into a blank slate...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet is out with an injury. 
Symboli Kris S changed her path.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A Kikuka Sho without the two of them is an 
entirely different beast. How should we 
interpret this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
You could call it an anticlimax. Yet seen 
from another angle, this is—an 
opportunity!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: ...I don't like it.
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Unacceptable, unacceptable, unacceptable! 
What was that battle for?! What was that 
race even for?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Renowned warlords wager their dreams, 
devise clever strategies, and clash with 
all-out slashes!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Doing that is who we are! Isn't that what 
makes us Umamusume, damn it!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Where am I supposed to strike down this 
blade raised to the heavens!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason was furious. At the situation, 
at fate, at everything.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Very well. In that case— Do not expect me 
to walk a predetermined path.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Let's pursue them, Trainer.
choice_data_list: ...A follow-up attack?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, the enemy lies at the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I know not why Lord Kris S hath turned her 
back, but— if she fleeth, I have no choice 
but to pursue and strike!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I, too, shall head for the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)!
choice_data_list: H-Hold on a second!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unlike the Classic Triple Crown, the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn) is a race where Senior Class 
Umamusume also compete.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The rivals besides Symboli Kris S are 
formidable too. This is truly an uncharted 
battlefield...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Aargh, I refuse to run in an anticlimactic 
Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
No matter what anyone says, it has to be 
the Tenno Sho (Autumn)! I will never back 
down!
choice_data_list: No Reason...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I—I want to fight... Staking the next era 
alongside my fated rivals!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She must feel utterly empty inside, with 
the long-awaited showdown called off. 
But...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As a Trainer, I cannot send my general 
into an unknown deathtrap."
choice_data_list: Our goal is the Kikuka Sho, No Reason.
Our goal is the Kikuka Sho, No Reason.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
choice_data_list:
With your body as it is now, you'll be at 
a disadvantage in the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

With your body as it is now, you'll be at 
a disadvantage in the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her physical growth is still slightly 
lagging behind. It's obvious she'll just 
get beaten back.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Is it really that important, Trainer?
choice_data_list: No matter what.
Because I just have to.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Even after being told this much?
choice_data_list: Yeah, no matter how much they say it.
Yeah, no matter how much they say it,

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Very well. In that case—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Fired! We're fired! This is the end of the 
line for us!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Never again shall I race beside thee! 
Begone! Begone, begone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We are being ordered to leave. I sense... 
a storm of destiny.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marching on to the Tenno Sho (Autumn) 
together is hell. Cutting ties right here 
is also hell. If that is the case...
choice_data_list:
No Reason... let's stick to the standard 
path! I'm begging you!

No Reason... let's take the orthodox path! 
Please!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
choice_data_list:
I want to see you become the ruler of them 
all!

I want to see you become the ruler of it 
all!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: ――!? Ruler of the realm...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To do that, I must head into the battles 
I need to face and deliver solid results."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of the future, I must gain 
experience in long-distance GⅠ races as 
well. That is why...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Even if no one else walks that path, 
you're telling me to press on to the 3000m 
Kikuka Sho?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, you just gotta stay true to yourself 
and keep moving forward!

Yeah, we should keep moving forward 
without wavering!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If your ultimate goal is to stand supreme 
under the heavens, you must not change 
your course based on short-term 
circumstances."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That was the judgment of true greatness. 
That was the path No Reason was meant to 
choose."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Good grief, you are quite the 
stubborn one yourself.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: First, a council! A discussion! However—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Depending on how this conversation goes, 
you may very well still be fired.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's talk!
Yeah, let's talk!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, a very, very long war council 
began. After several days of heated debate 
with No Reason...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those days were brutal... more exhausting 
than any training ever could be.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Auuugh, No Reason-chan and her Trainer are 
still bickering...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fighting is... bad, you know? But there's 
no way I could stop them...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Still... with neither Gimlet-chan nor Kris 
S-chan here, and No Reason-chan feeling 
lost too...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Could this mean...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And finally—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... Very well, I understand. 
With this, the matter is settled.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I'll go to the Kikuka Sho for you. But 
you'll do exactly as I say!
choice_data_list: Understood...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so—they finally came to an agreement.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, Trainer, your plan is far too naive. 
It's so soft it'd make a tanuki do a 
handstand in disbelief.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I refuse to obey!
choice_data_list: No Reason...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
It feels like... over there... it's always 
so tense...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, based on pure ability, they should 
be the top contender for the Kikuka Sho, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason and I made a secret pact and 
pushed forward toward the Kikuka Sho.
